## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and which issue or feature is being addressed.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code style update / formatting

## Testing & Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (`.editorconfig`)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have run `dotnet test` locally and all unit/architecture tests pass cleanly
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
